_comment: The content security policies of the runner's two pages (ADR 0170). The single source: RunnerHeaders sends them, front/code-runner and the Playwright mock content origin read the same file. {ancestors} is replaced with the origins that may frame the runner (the tenant's front and admin). exec.html has no frame-ancestors on purpose: the runner frames it and the runner is sandboxed, an opaque origin that no frame-ancestors source can match (not even 'self'), so any restriction would block it; the page has no network and an opaque origin, and runs only code that arrives with the nonce in its URL fragment.
